notes.title: Update on VAGUE (feat. Release Date)
notes.notes:
Following the unexpected attention sparked by a mysterious Reddit Post from an unknown user, the response from the local (Bruneian) community has been nothing short of astonishing. Word has even reached me through a friend's connection, indicating a surprising level of interest in my game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729738/04e246b73c151e341ddaa25d2b49e831bb61104a.jpg

This influx of attention brings a mix of emotions for me. 🫠

As a solo developer, VAGUE is planned to be a short interactive horror experience, but the sudden surge in popularity has both motivated and challenged me to elevate the game's quality to meet the growing expectations.

As a response, one of the significant enhancements I've focused on is a improving the graphics for the in-game characters. Here's a glimpse of the original version for the main character:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729738/c0c77fe6cf5ab16e13978bd9d9e0f54661637856.jpg

And here's the updated version:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729738/b68528a4ded222910f55973b723d40499ee63e0d.jpg

Initially designed with "good enough PS3" graphics in mind, I found myself compelled to elevate it to a semi-realistic PS4 standard. I believe I've made considerable progress in achieving this goal!

With that, I had to delay the release date to November 2024 (a year from now).

For latest updates on the game, you can follow me on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube!

That wraps up the latest updates from me, and I'm eager to reveal more aspects of the game soon! Until then, farewell!

- Wollabebes
